item.title: Bonapartism
item.description: Bonapartism Bonapartism in these deposits is the political force that treated the Napoleonic name as a popular and military title to rule France after Waterloo—distinct from legitimism, from Orléanist parliamentary culture, and from republican socialism.

item.title: Charte constitutionnelle
item.description: Charte constitutionnelle The Charte constitutionnelle is the constitutional text of Restoration and July Monarchy France—1814’s granted charter and 1830’s revision—through which Duvergier’s parliamentary history reads every cabinet fight of the Bourbon and Orléanist decades.
